svg.title: Site map, to scale
svg.desc: Both statues to scale from layout/statue-layout.json, one statue enlarged with every step drawn corner to corner as its across and along legs. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: Site map — top view, to scale
Left: the whole site on a 1 m grid. Right: one statue enlarged. Every step is measured CORNER TO CORNER, between the two corners
that face each other, as two legs: ACROSS (x) and ALONG the apex-to-apex line (y), dashed, in metres. Lay it out with a tape and a
right angle. The brown number is the straight tape from corner to corner. Statue 2 is statue 1 turned 180° about the centre: the same steps.
From the bench facing either statue, T1 is on your left.
apex to apex 16.85 m corner to corner
One statue, enlarged (both are the same)
Towers are 408 × 408 mm, turned 45°: a corner points along the apex line.
Blue dots: the corners measured between. Centre to centre is 0.58 m more along y.
cord T3 → T2 · data to T2 (2 lines)
cord apex → T3 · data to T3 and T2
cord apex → T5 · data to T5 and T6
cord T5 → T6 · data to T6 (2 lines)
Metres, between the facing corners. x is across the site, y is along the apex-to-apex line.
